chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn from his father 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the circumcision of a child, whether it is done on the seventh day as is from the Sunnah, or if it is delayed, which is better? He said, 'The seventh day is from the Sunnah, and if it is delayed, there is no harm.'
ai.seo_question: When is the best time to circumcise a child according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the fiqh of infant circumcision by affirming the seventh day as the ideal Sunnah while validating flexibility for later performance. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing ritual perfection with practical ease, ensuring that the act remains a valid purification rite regardless of minor delays.
